brief: Review the open defect register for Harrowgate Ridge ahead of the forecast heat event, prioritising any outstanding work related to cooling, ventilation, or oil levels for completion before the event begins. If an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Refer to MG-023, SOP-016, and MG-021 for detailed ageing, defect review, and de-rating criteria.
